metadata.title: Chern holonomy under the first and second Chern--Ricci flows
metadata.abstract: We compare the Chern holonomy of the first and second Chern-Ricci flows on compact complex manifolds. For the first flow, we construct an explicit immortal pluriclosed solution on a complex two-torus with full and restricted holonomy $U(2)$, except at one finite time when both groups are $U(1)^2$; its smooth limit has holonomy $SU(2)$. The solution is uniformly nondegenerate and has bounds of every fixed differential order for all time. In contrast, the second Chern-Ricci flow preserves full and restricted Chern holonomy under the natural unitary identification, including the initial time and nonclosed groups. The proof combines preservation of a connection reduction, positive-time analyticity, and a path-transport comparison. As an application, the optimal minimum mean curvature on a holomorphic bundle is unchanged when metrics are restricted to any realizable full and restricted holonomy class. An explicit projected-curvature source explains the failure of the corresponding Ricci-flow holonomy argument.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Chern–Ricci 流的 holonomy 比较
analysis.workSummary: 第一 Chern–Ricci 流有复二维环面上的显式永生 pluriclosed 解：完整及限制 holonomy 除一个有限时刻为 U(1)² 外均为 U(2)，光滑极限则为 SU(2)，且解一致非退化、每个固定阶导数全时有界。相反，紧复流形上的第二 Chern–Ricci 流在自然酉识别下保持完整及限制 Chern holonomy，包含初时刻和非闭群。作为应用，将全纯向量丛度量限制到任意可实现的完整及限制 holonomy 类，不改变最优最小平均曲率。
techniques: 投影曲率源项与显式流
analysis.breakthrough: 同时给出第一流有限时刻和极限 holonomy 改变的反例，以及第二流连完整、非闭群均保持的精确结论。
analysis.limitations: 需区分第一、第二流与完整、限制 holonomy；有限时间保持不自动传至无穷时光滑极限。向量丛应用的 holonomy 类必须可实现。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF 全 19 页文本提取完整、页数一致、无短文本页，全文检索未观察到生成式 AI 使用披露。此状态不推断作者实际是否使用模型。

analysis.priorityReason: 流与联络结构的重要交叉，应审读两流定义、酉识别及解析性用途。
